نبذة

Cutting Edge Hair Lounge is located in Cluster U, JLT serving the JLT community. We are close to the DAMAC Metro Station for your convenience. We are an experienced team that offers a variety of on-trend treatments from hair to nails, waxing to facials, and relaxing massage. We promise to give you the best quality services for a price that is right for you.
